        stack = [source]
    elif isinstance(source, list):
        stack = list(source)
    else:
        stack = [source]
    while stack:
        item = stack.pop()
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            stack.extend(item.values())
        elif isinstance(item, list):
            stack.extend(item)

print(url_candidates[:20])
